name: harness-ship
description: Idea → shipped, humans on the ends. A root-orchestrated development and QA workflow with separate acceptance design, role-routed implementation, and explicit human judgment gates.

interface.longDescription: Turn an idea into an accepted change through clarification, feasibility, specification, a separate versioned acceptance-design contract, root-orchestrated role-routed TDD implementation, fixed-point review, exact-SHA delivery evidence, post-handoff QA testing, and a plain-language acceptance report.
defaultPrompt: Set up harness-ship for this repository.
Run the development workflow for this feature.
Design the versioned acceptance contract for this current spec.
Implement this approved ticket with the configured agent role profiles.
Implement this ticket test-first with an evidence-backed red-green loop.
Run the testing workflow for the current change.
